newsitem.title: USA: Primark to buy back 1.2 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Primark to buy back 1.2 million shares.

text.p: Primark Corp said its board has authorized the repurchase of up to 1.2 million additional shares of common stock, bringing the total authorized by the board to 2.2 million common shares.
It said it has completed the purchase of the previously announced 1.0 million share common stock repurchase program announced March 19.

The company said it is taking actions to increase the stock purchase authority contained in its credit agreements. Primark said it intends to immediately commence the additional share repurchase program and acquire shares from time to time in the open market and/or in privately negotiated transactions.

Joseph Kasputys, chairman and chief executive said, "I continue to believe the current trading range for Primark stock to be an attractive level for our investment and this additional repurchase program is an excellent measure for the company to take to increase shareholder value."
